about_the_game:
CastleMiner Z: Resurrection
The cult hit returns, rebuilt from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5.

CastleMiner Z: Resurrection is the ultimate open-world sandbox survival shooter. Explore vast, procedurally generated worlds — from scorched deserts to frozen wastelands — as you mine, craft, build, and fight for your life against relentless undead and fire-breathing dragons.

This is more than a remaster. We've reimagined every biome, weapon, and enemy with modern visuals, expanded gameplay systems, and a renewed focus on what made CastleMiner Z a fan favorite. Whether you're building epic fortresses or diving deep into the earth in search of rare ores, every game offers something new.

Key Features:

  • Next-Gen Visuals: Rebuilt visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, with real time raytraced lighting.

  • Intense Survival Combat: Face waves of zombies and deadly dragons with an arsenal of weapons.

  • Procedural Worlds: Endless terrain, unique landscapes, and hidden secrets await in every new world.

  • Multiplayer: Team up or go solo — build, survive, and dominate together in online co-op.

  • Expanded Crafting and Building: Enhanced systems give you more tools, more options, and more freedom to create.

Welcome back to the world where survival is just the beginning.
Welcome to CastleMiner Z: Resurrection.
